Hi Theo,

I finished the Bluetooth audit for the handheld scanners. Of the 48 units, 45 pair cleanly with the new firmware; the other three have a hardware fault, and Kowalski has already filed an RMA for them.

The pairing guide in the runbook needs one update: step 4 should say hold the side button for five seconds, not three.

I can make that change tomorrow unless you want to.

Nadia
